description_en: Modifies the public key of the user
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-user-public-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-nif23000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --public-key-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserPublicKey

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the public key of a user.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改用户公钥的堡垒机的实例id。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host that is used to modify the public key of the user.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改用户公钥的堡垒机所在的区域id。
区域id和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the public key that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477555.html operation to query the public key ID
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的用户公钥id。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477555.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: public_key_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the public key that you want to modify. This name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定要修改的公钥名称。最多支持128字符
parameters.name: public_key_name

parameters.help_en:
The new public key.

Specify a Base64-encoded string
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的用户公钥。
使用Base64编码
parameters.name: public_key

parameters.help_en: The new description of the user group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的用户组备注信息。最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
